statement: NVIDIA data center revenue reached $75.2 billion in the quarter ended April 26, 2026, out of $81.6 billion total, after a record $62.3 billion (up 75% YoY) reported in February 2026.
why: Sequential growth of roughly $13 billion in a single quarter of data center revenue is the strongest available read on how fast accelerator demand is actually converting to shipments.

impact.mechanism: Record and still-accelerating data center revenue confirms that orders are being filled at scale, pulling through memory, packaging and networking supply chains.
